caci_worksheets.title: CACI - Colitis Worksheet

criteria.ame_must_review: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note from the treating physician
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] Condition is stable with no effects that would interfere with flight duties, AND [ ] No surgery for the condition in the last 6 (six) weeks.
[ ] None or mild diarrhea (less than 4 bowel movements/day) with or without mild abdominal pain/cramping AND [ ] No severe abdominal symptoms or fatigue which limits activity.
[ ] Crohn’s disease, ulcerative colitis, microscopic colitis, or irritable bowel syndrome Any other causes require an FAA decision.

criteria.ame_must_review: Medications for condition KEY: Interleukin Inhibitors (IL) Phosphodiesterase-4 Enzyme Inhibitor (PDE4) Tumor necrosis factor inhibitors (TNF) Selective Adhesion- Molecule Inhibitor (SAM)
criteria.acceptable_certification_criteria: [ ] One or more of the following: - Guanylate Cyclase-C (GC-C) Agonist - linaclotide(Linzess), plecanatide (Trulance) - Sodium/Hydrogen Exchanger 3 Inhibitor - tenapanor (Ibsrela) - Steroids - Oral formulations prednisone 20 mg/day equivalent or less (see steroid conversion calculator ) - Oral budesonide 9mg or less - Steroid foams or enemas/ budesonide enema - azathioprine (Imuran) - hyoscyamine - use 1-2 times a week with no side effects and no-fly 72 hours after use - loperamide less than or equal to 16 mg a day and no side effects - mercaptopurine (6-MP) - mesalamine (Asacol, Pentasa, Lialda) - methotrexate (Trexall) - sulfasalazine (Azulfidine) - Any single medication listed below after a 2-week ground trial and: - No post-dose observation time: - JAK: tofacitinib (Xeljanz) and upadacitinib (Rinvoq) - 4-hour post-dose observation time: - TNF: adalimumab (Humira and all biosimilars),certolizumab (Cimzia), golimumab (Simponi) - IL: guselkumab (Tremfya), mirikizumab (Omvoh), risankizumab (Skyrizi), ustekinumab (Stelara) - SAM: vedolizumab (Entyvio) - 24-hour post-dose observation time: - TNF: infliximab (Inflectra, Remicade, Renflexis)
